description: Vogelbuurt-Noord 1918-19 single-storey cottages (Brede, Derde, Eerste, Korte, Lange, Tweede, Vierde, Vijfde Vogelstraat, Vogelplantsoen, Zamenhofstraat): 5.0-6.8 m red brick fronts of one 3.3 m storey (door foot on a 0.65 m plinth) under a low tiled roof behind a grey gutter; a small window, a wide two-light window and a green door in a cream frame, door first on the mirrored fronts

match.note: BAG 1918-19, 3DBAG eaves 3.3-4.3 m; widths 5-6.8 m; the 3DBAG eaves (4.1-4.8 m, a mean over the hipped roof) is not the gutter: the strip gutter is at 3.4 m, so the type scores the strip cornice (frontEavesM) and drops the 3DBAG roof-rise test

gutter.note: Brede Vogelstraat 5-11 (2025-09-22): a thin grey gutter lip at 3.4 m over a dark soffit about 0.3 m deep, tile roof behind it

door-right.note: dark green single leaf 0.9 m wide with a cream frame and a transom light, door foot on the 0.65 m plinth; mirrored when the strip reads the door on the left

rhythm.bays: small window, wide window, door (mirrored: door, wide window, small window)
rhythm.symmetry: mirror pairs about the party wall

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2025-09-22, 40 px/m, gridded: eaves gutter 3.4 m over image foot (the facade foot is 0.65 m up, a plinth: door 0.65-2.5 m); window heads 2.55 m, sills 1.15 m, wide window 2.0 m, small window 1.0 m at sill 1.6 m, door 0.9 m in a cream frame with transom; Tweede/Brede Vogelstraat share the design
strip.jpg 2021-06-15: Eerste Vogelstraat 19: small window, wide window, door at the right edge; Vierde Vogelstraat 2-6 and 3-11 (2017-05-15, 2022-05-10): door, wide window, small window (the mirror)

schemaLimits: the small high window (sill 1.6 m, head 2.45 m) is drawn at the wide window's height
the 0.65 m raised plinth: storey height 3.3 m includes it
brick bands under the gutter and the small ventilation bricks are not drawn
notes: Palette: brick #8f6a58 is one tone for the buurt, not per pand: strips of one date differ by 2x in exposure (raw brick medians 77-221 on 2025-09-22) and the trim normalisation locks onto hedges and the dark timber band, so measuredWall is off. The tone is the median of the 8 darker-exposed strips (raw 86-105,66-85,58-74) lifted x1.5; a reviewer should pin the row if a photo disagrees.
